_schema.description: Board-wide invalidation/annotation registry (board-integrity pass 2026-08-04). One committed, machine-readable place where superseded, flattered, or absent-not-failed numbers are FLAGGED so prior bakes/evals never sit on stolen wins. Consumers: `freeze_check --annotations` (default = this file; floor rows print '— (absent)' for absent-not-failed axes, TSV gains n_measured/absent/annotations columns) and `scripts/v_next/gauntlet.py` (warning badge + tooltip reason on affected cells/fields + caption line). Entries are append-only; never delete — supersede with a new entry and point `fix_path` at the resolution.

entry_fields.id: stable kebab-case identifier, referenced from docs and tooltips
entry_fields.kind: one of: 'invalidated' (the number is wrong/superseded — do not cite), 'annotated' (the number is real but must be read with the stated caveat), 'absent-not-failed' (the field is missing because the instrument did not exist / was not run for this cell; absence is 'not measured', DISTINCT from a measured fail — consumers print '— (absent)' and state both n/8 (registered absent=not-passed rule) and n/m-measured forms)
entry_fields.fields: list of fulleval dot-paths the entry covers; a path covers itself and any deeper subpath (segment-boundary prefix match), e.g. 'rank.hfnlproxy' covers 'rank.hfnlproxy.per_ref_mean'
entry_fields.scope: predicate object selecting which fulleval cells the entry applies to; exactly one key of: {"missing": "dot.path"} (field absent or null), {"present": "dot.path"} (field present and non-null), {"names": ["bake", ...]} (exact bake-name list), {"all": true} (every cell)
entry_fields.reason: one-sentence human reason shown in tooltips/reports
entry_fields.evidence: commit sha(s) / doc section that established the finding
entry_fields.fix_path: what un-flags a cell (re-measure path, tooling, or 'none — permanent caveat')

entries.reason: Every per-band `srocc` published before 2026-08-06 is an ABSOLUTE value cut on fixed [0,1] deciles, and on the tail bands that combination is not a usable statistic. Because |.| is monotone in the depth of an inversion, the column ranked models by how wrong their top band was -- the published leader `coherent924_selected` (|B9| 0.4493) is the population's MOST anti-correlated model at -0.4493. The band itself is degenerate independently of the sign: 43 pairs from 11 of 49 references spanning 0.0194 MOS, split-half r_SB 0.711 (bar 0.90), model population -0.263..-0.015. Two further defects in the same grid: CID22 B0/B1 were structurally EMPTY and B2 held one pair (TID B9 empty, B8 one pair), and the bottom band closed at 0.0 so LIVE's 21 sub-zero DMOS pairs fell out of every band (its published rows summed to 758 of 779). DO NOT CITE any pre-2026-08-06 per-band value, and never the `srocc` field on any band. `freeze_check` reports these cells' F8 as ABSENT rather than scoring them.

entries.reason: Every F8 PASS/FAIL statement made before 2026-08-06 used `|B9| >= 0.15 AND |B3| >= 0.0` on CID22's fixed-decile bands. Both halves were defective: the bar was applied to an ABSOLUTE value (so a collapsed band scored like a healthy one and a more deeply inverted band scored HIGHER), and `|B3| >= 0.0` is unfalsifiable against an absolute value, making F8 a one-sided test in practice. MEASURED board-wide: 167 of 280 cells PASSED the old bar; of the 120 that can be checked against a signed recomputation, 82 passed while only 2 were positive. F8 now reads the SIGNED top and bottom USABLE bands of the appendix-V scheme with a DERIVED floor (`BAND_HIGH = 0.09` = the new band's reference-clustered marginal 95% CI half-width 0.0866, ceil-2dp; `BAND_LOW = 0.0`, now a real bar). FINAL -- user-approved 2026-08-06 (was REGISTERED-PENDING-USER-ACK at entry time). Note the honest consequence: on the recut board all 120 cells pass (top-band population +0.262..+0.514, zero negatives), so F8 is now a REGRESSION GUARD with no discriminating power on this population -- its predecessor only appeared to discriminate because it was ranking inversions.
